label: 21. Elegg was saying someone deliberately released…

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Elegg was saying someone deliberately released this thing, right?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Fingers crossed that it isn't a Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I believe there's a high chance that it is.
I think so too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah... I figured as much,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but who, tho?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Nihilister has seen better days.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Liberalio's probably wandering somewhere near Eden.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Indivilia got absolutely wrecked.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Who else is left?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Could it be a different heretic altogether?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: We can't say for sure that what we've encountered so far is all there is.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Sure, we've seen some near the Ark,

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: but that doesn't necessarily mean we've encountered them all.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but break it down for me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are we talking a few more stragglers or even a hundred-strong army?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Either is possible.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Great. Fantastic.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I don't get why you're so worked up.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I mean, we practically eat Heretics for breakfast, haha!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You always have been rather... optimistic about this stuff.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That's one of my positive traits!
Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes?
Are there any Heretic sightings apart from the ones we just mentioned?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No, none.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Considering how vast the Surface is,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: it wouldn't be surprising if there's something out there that has simply gone undetected.
Actually, I started to feel a little scared myself.
It doesn't matter. No matter how many there are, we'll defeat them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There you go, guys!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Being scared is a perfectly reasonable reaction.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey, hold up!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What if we do a 180 on this theory?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Could that mean we're gonna stumble upon some Pilgrims too?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That's possible.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: that makes me feel better.
